soho: She respected these Englishmen, and wanted to see London, and the English horses, and the tailor-made suits, and could remember hearing how wonderful the shops were, from an Aunt who had married and lived in Soho.

About Soho we went before the light;
We went, unresting six, craving new fun,
The lamps of Soho made large greasy spots of light upon the pavement.
